H01.description: close() does not clear the pending debounce timer, so a debounced rerun can still fire after the optimizer has been closed.

H02.description: close() never resolves depOptimizationProcessing or the enqueued processing promises (only a later rerun does), so callers awaiting optimization can hang forever once the optimizer is closed and no rerun happens.

H03.description: Removes the promise resolution from rerun's closed branch now that close() resolves them.

H04.description: Removes the redundant resolveEnqueuedProcessingPromises call in the post-run closed branch since close() now resolves them.

I01.description: Optional peer require fallback handling in the rolldown CJS external plugin; unrelated to the reviewed change and not shown to be present at head.

I02.description: Adds a yarn.lock fallback for lockfile hashing; a later feature-level fix unrelated to the reviewed optimizer close logic.

I03.description: Patches-dir hashing for nub lockfile; unrelated to the change's reviewed behaviour and not evidenced at head.

I04.description: Fixes the yarn.lock fallback added later by I02, so the issue was introduced after head.
